message.content: {"hts_code": "7410.21.0000", "reason": "Stamped circular copper-alloy (bronze) blanks not yet finished into cymbals are classified as unwrought/semi-finished copper-alloy articles under heading 7410 (copper foil/plates of copper alloys) or 7419/7409 by form, but since the blanks are stamped copper-alloy discs destined to be made into cymbals (HTSUS 9209/9209.99 parts of musical instruments applies only to finished parts), the best fit is 7410.21.0000 for copper-alloy foil and plate of copper-alloy sheets."}

predicted_reason: Stamped circular copper-alloy (bronze) blanks not yet finished into cymbals are classified as unwrought/semi-finished copper-alloy articles under heading 7410 (copper foil/plates of copper alloys) or 7419/7409 by form, but since the blanks are stamped copper-alloy discs destined to be made into cymbals (HTSUS 9209/9209.99 parts of musical instruments applies only to finished parts), the best fit is 7410.21.0000 for copper-alloy foil and plate of copper-alloy sheets.
